text: Your team moves fast. But your product context can fall behind.
The document says one thing. A new request says another. Which version should your team build?
Orchestra brings the question back to your project. Choose the source, then ask what is actually in scope.
Check the evidence, not just the answer. This demo uses evidence-only mode, without an AI provider.
Read the original requirement: CSV export is included. PDF export is not.
Preflight checks the agent's context. Missing acceptance criteria remain a blocker. A context pack doesn't prove the work is complete.
Orchestra. Product Brain for High Speed Teams. Connect evidence, make explicit decisions, and give your team a shared understanding of what to build next.
